# 503. Next Greater Element II

## Solution 1 (time O(log(n)), space O(log(n)))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def nextGreaterElements(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        n = len(nums)
        ans = [-1] * n
        s = []
        for i in range(n * 2 - 1):
            while s and nums[s[-1]] < nums[i % n]:
                ans[s.pop()] = nums[i % n]
            s.append(i % n)
        return ans
```
